description: A palm of deep red scales, each one overlapping the next. Emberjaw sheds them where it basks.
lore: Everybody who works the black rock walks on [[monsters/lava_salamander|Emberjaw]]. That stone cooks a boot sole in a day and a half; a palm of red scale, cut to shape and stitched on with the overlap running heel to toe, does a season. Thirty gold, never argued, because the alternative is coming back barefoot over ground that stays warm the whole way.

The cobblers read the returned soles the way other people read a road. Even wear, heel to toe: he walked in and he walked out. Worn through at the toe on both feet and nowhere else: he ran, a long way, and did not turn round to see what he was running from. There is a cobbler at the last fire who keeps the bad ones in a box under his bench. He will show you if you ask twice, and he will not give you the names, because half of them still come in for resoling.
gm_notes: Wear patterns as testimony from people who will not testify. The box under the bench is a readable archive of every panic on the black rock.
